title: Find a place by name and add it to a trip
goal: NERV can add a place to a trip by name, after the owner confirms the geocoded match
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "yes to both": adding places to Hobo trips by chat ("aggiungi Rocca Calascio al trip di agosto") via MCP behind NERV's approval; and the owner's idea the same day to set an image on a Hobo place from NERV chat (nerv:F-143). Italian is required for every model-facing feature.

hobo_find_place uses the existing geocode endpoint (server/map-adapter.ts); hobo_add_place_to_trip creates the place if it is a new candidate and appends it to the trip (or the named day), validated with zod
Idempotency table keyed by requestId; tests: add twice with one requestId writes once, unknown trip or day refused with the reason, ambiguous name returns several candidates (NERV asks the owner)
privacy: Invented places, trips and images only; no API keys, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: geocoding and trip writes exist behind the REST API; the work is two MCP tools and the idempotency table. Not a measurement.
